title: orobanche minor var. barbata
intro: Orobanche minor var. barbata, commonly known as the broomrape, is a parasitic flowering plant that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Orobanche minor var. barbata include its use as an anticoagulant, antiplatelet, and vasodilator, which can help to prevent blood clots and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
